sentences.text: The season 6 finale cliffhanger includes a cameo by Stephen Hawking (Part I of "Descent").
===Characters' cameo appearances in later series===
The film also features cameos by two actors from the sister television series Star Trek: Voyager, which was in its third season at release.
Picardo's fellow Voyager actor Ethan Phillips, who played Neelix, cameos as a nightclub maître d' in the holodeck scene.
Producer Harve Bennett made a cameo as a Starfleet admiral.
Meyer was a friend of Auberjonois and offered him a chance to cameo months before filming.
Nurse Christine Chapel cameos in the script's climax.
Nimoy, who had earlier requested $1 million to cameo on The Next Generation, appeared in the two-part episode "Unification" that aired during November 1991 to increase interest in the feature film.
Grace Lee Whitney, who played Janice Rand in the original Star Trek series, made a cameo appearance as "Woman in Cafeteria".
Fuller discussed the series' casting with Mae Jemison, the first black woman in space who made a cameo appearance in an episode of The Next Generation.
Additionally, Jamie Lee Curtis makes a cameo appearance as "Control", the cybernetically-enhanced director of Section 31.

James Doohan's Original Series character Montgomery "Scotty" Scott had an offscreen cameo appearance in the first-season finale, voiced by Matthew Wolf, before Martin Quinn was cast in the role for the second-season finale.
Chris Doohan, the son of the original Scotty, James Doohan, makes a cameo appearance in the transporter room.
Chris Doohan previously cameoed in Star Trek: The Motion Picture.
Greg Grunberg has a vocal cameo as Kirk's alcoholic stepfather.
Star Trek fan and Carnegie Mellon University professor Randy Pausch (who died on July 25, 2008) cameoed as a Kelvin crew member, and has a line of dialogue.
But Shatner wanted to share Nimoy's major role, and did not want a cameo, despite his character's death in Star Trek Generations.
Leonard Nimoy has a cameo appearance as Spock Prime.

Leonard Nimoy appears in a photo cameo appearance as Spock Prime, alongside George Takei, Walter Koenig, William Shatner, James Doohan, DeForest Kelley, and Nichelle Nichols as the Prime versions of Sulu, Chekov, Kirk, Scott, McCoy, and Uhura, respectively.
Jeff Bezos cameos as an alien Starfleet official.
Carlo Ancelotti has a brief cameo as a doctor at Starbase Yorktown.
